hook.name: BagrHookV4E
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook that deploys tokens as single-sided concentrated Uniswap v4 positions. Restricts liquidity from overlapping the curve range. After each swap, observes whether the pool price has crossed the graduation tick and emits a Graduated event. Uses a flat static LP fee with no dynamic fee ramp or anti-sniper window.
